create_camera_widget: create a CameraWidget instance with a viz object to manage camera yaw, pitch, and fov settings
set_camera_position: call set_camera with dv and du deltas to adjust yaw and pitch within valid bounds
render_camera_ui: invoke the CameraWidget call method to render imgui checkboxes for camera control and NeRF output toggles
configure_camera_kwargs: configure camera_kwargs EasyDict with yaw, pitch, fov, anim, and speed parameters for viewpoint control
toggle_camera_mode: toggle camera_mode and output_nerf flags via imgui checkboxes to enable viewpoint control and lowres output
